4 - Business case

Expected scenario: 35.2 breakdowns prevented per year, unplanned downtime down 57.9%, net saving $1,236,971 on a 30-machine line.

Conservative scenario (only 40% of alarms acted on in time): still $699,853 saved and 32.8% less downtime - inside the 15-30% range reported by published industrial studies.
How to reproduce every number on this page:
pip install -r requirements.txt
python train_model.py   train both models
python -m src.alert_system   replay + work orders
python main.py all   full pipeline + this dashboard
python api/app.py   serve the REST API
